cases.title: Mall Shooting — Minute 12
cases.presentation: Police report the shooter is pinned down in the east wing. The food court (west) has been cleared but not secured. 15 casualties are there. You are assigned to a Rescue Task Force with 4 officers.
cases.question: Your RTF priorities?
options: B: Wait in the cold zone until the building is fully secure.
C: Intubate the first unresponsive patient.
D: Enter the food court with escort: rapid hemorrhage control (TQs, packing), airway positioning, chest seals; move casualties to the CCP; minimal time on each.
cases.explanation: RTF's job is warm-zone TECC and rapid extraction. Prolonged procedures expose the team; police manage the threat.
cases.clinicalPearl: Stop the bleeding, get them out, keep moving.

cases.title: The Train Carriage
cases.presentation: An explosive device detonates inside a crowded rail carriage. A 30-year-old is walking, deafened, mildly short of breath, with a ruptured right eardrum. SpO2 94%.
cases.question: Best management?
options: A: Needle decompression for all blast victims.
C: Treat as at risk for blast lung: re-triage, O2, monitor SpO2/work of breathing, transport for observation — communicate in writing.
cases.explanation: Enclosed-space blast + TM rupture + mild hypoxia = high risk of evolving blast lung. Keep him under observation; he may deteriorate hours later.
cases.clinicalPearl: Enclosed blast, walking patient — still watch the lungs.

cases.title: Second Device
cases.presentation: Twenty minutes after a car bomb, EMS and fire have clustered at a single CCP in a plaza next to a parked van with blacked-out windows.
cases.question: What should command do?
options: A: Relocate the CCP and staging away and out of line of sight; request police clearance of the van and the new site; disperse vehicles.
D: Move all patients into the van for shelter.
cases.explanation: Secondary devices are designed to kill responders at predictable gathering points. Relocate, disperse, and get bomb-squad clearance.
cases.clinicalPearl: The second bomb is for you.
